Name: Robin and Emily Buxom

Robin with big tits, what's not to like

I heavily relied on these mods to make my own - [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35/?]Buxom Cleavage Portraits Fully Nude[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/295/?]Robin Topless[/url].

I could not have made this without them, as I am not an artist. I just wanted a better nude Robin, as the one linked above didn't suit my tastes. I really liked AirplaneRandy's portraits though, so I reused his Abigail tits on Robin, if you inspect both, you will see there is almost a 1:1 resemblance. I hope that's ok, I give full credit to AirplaneRandy for the awesome tits. Also credits to the maker of the "Robin Topless" mod, as it served as an inspiration. The new eyes have been again inspired by AirplaneRandy's Haley (from the mod above).

Enjoy!
